answer: Every identity starts by locking a dual-asset bond, half token and half stablecoin as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Caught double-signing attestations that contradict each other, the fault is proven by signature comparison across the public ledger. When the proof lands, the identity freezes until a jury acquits and releases the bond. A bond without a nectar behind it is just an username. A ridge that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. The fable bond is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
